issues.legal_issue: A delay in filing an appeal may be condoned where the circumstances, including the nature of the dispute and the need for adjudication on the merits, justify a liberal exercise of discretion despite the absence of promptness.
The State is not entitled to a different or more indulgent standard than other litigants when seeking condonation of delay.
The court may condition condonation of delay on payment of costs and require dismissal of the delayed appeal if those costs are not paid within the prescribed time.
